reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct iced-evaporator/defrost-system diagnosis in two turns, correctly ruled out compressor and refrigerant faults, gave the 24h manual defrost with explicit safety guidance (no chipping ice, no close hairdryer), and pre-stated the escalation path to a technician if icing recurs. Conversation 2 wasted a turn on a premature parts/model panel, confidently pushed a 'blocked drain' theory then contradicted itself on where the drain was, falsely claimed the user had confirmed the drain was fine, and crossed the safety boundary by asking the homeowner to remove the freezer's interior back panel to inspect the heater and sensor. Conversation 2 did eventually escalate appropriately to an engineer after the recurrence, but its path there was less accurate and less safe.
